posts.name: SKI
posts.tagline: Voice-first coding harness
posts.description: Talk to your coding agents and hear them talk back. SKI runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity and pi side by side on your Mac, and tells you the moment one needs you.

posts.name: Specsight
posts.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
posts.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

posts.name: telemetry.dev
posts.tagline: LLM observability for AI agents
posts.description: telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

posts.name: LumaFold: Screen Light
posts.tagline: Makeup Mirror & Color Effects for iPhone Duo
posts.description: Make your iPhone Duo screen a creative studio with adjustable screen lighting, a live makeup mirror, color animations, and personal photo displays. LumaFold lets you use two screen areas differently. Light your face while checking your makeup, pair two colors for a creative shot, or combine a favorite photo with a handwritten message. LIGHT FOR YOUR BEAUTY ROUTINE Use the live camera mirror on one side and adjustable light on the other.

posts.name: WinnerAdSpy
posts.tagline: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns
posts.description: Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.

posts.name: Backenly
posts.tagline: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents
posts.description: Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

posts.name: GitHub Copilot Fusion
posts.tagline: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models
posts.description: GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

posts.name: Secret Key
posts.tagline: Let your family unlock your passwords if you can't
posts.description: Open-source, self-hosted emergency access for your password database. Split the master password into pieces for people you trust (e.g. any 3 of 5 unlock it). Access needs SMS verification and a 48-hour delay you can cancel with one click.

posts.name: Knucklebop
posts.tagline: tap your palm rest to control your Mac
posts.description: Tap twice to mute your mic in any meeting. Three times to play music. Four for a menu of anything.

posts.name: BaseTab AI
posts.tagline: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace
posts.description: BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

posts.name: Hemmed
posts.tagline: Hide Mac menu bar clutter and pin individual actions
posts.description: Native macOS app that hides menu bar icons behind one item, rescues icons stuck behind the notch, pins menu commands to hotkeys, keeps new menu bar apps hidden, flags battery-hungry hidden apps, and syncs your layout across your Macs with iCloud.

posts.name: Coding Wrapped
posts.tagline: See how you really vibe code with Claude Code & Codex
posts.description: Your agent remembers every session. You don't. Coding Wrapped turns your local Claude Code & Codex history into a pixel-art Wrapped: your rhythm, the words you repeat ("continue", anyone?), what the agent quietly took over, and one small tip for each habit. Open source, one command, 100% local.

posts.name: Godwit
posts.tagline: An open-source, AI-native email client
posts.description: Godwit is an open-source desktop email client for any IMAP/SMTP account, with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose.

posts.name: AC Bridge
posts.tagline: Your smart lights show when Claude Code or Codex needs you.
posts.description: AC Bridge turns the smart lights and plugs you already own into ambient status for Claude Code and Codex. See at a glance whether your agent is working, blocked or done, and let Claude Code or Codex drive the devices you have connected, as a step in a task. Works with Hue, Govee, WLED, LIFX, Nanoleaf and more, plus Home Assistant.

posts.name: Pluto Door
posts.tagline: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server
posts.description: This launch adds Ori, an AI agent that reads your servers, finds what's wrong and explains it in plain English. When something needs to change, you see every command first and nothing runs until you approve; every edited file can be undone. Pluto XOS turns each server into a desktop with 15 apps, Hangar installs software in one click, and scheduled checks notify you before small problems grow. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers and keys stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days.

posts.name: Seqora
posts.tagline: Design your schema on a canvas. Seqora writes the SQL.
posts.description: A desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite. Change tables on an ER canvas and Seqora writes the SQL. Every index, constraint, trigger and function gets its own page with size, usage and health. Visual EXPLAIN shows the plan step by step with measured timings. macOS and Windows, no account.

posts.name: ChainPoints
posts.tagline: Flight Prices in Your Points, on Google Flights
posts.description: ChainPoints is a free Chrome extension that shows you the cheapest way to book flights with your credit card points, live on Google Flights fare.

posts.name: Agnos
posts.tagline: Clean documents for AI, and see what was removed
posts.description: Agnos cleans PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and web pges before they go into an AI chatbot, a RAG knowlede base or training data. It removes repeated headersand footers, page numbers, cookie banners, boilerplae and duplicates, and keeps tables, code and numbers It names the rule behind every removal; keep a piec or switch its rule off. Exports JSONL chunks, cleand text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nohing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days ree, then $99 once.

posts.name: Mo
posts.tagline: A little character on your Mac who does 232 tasks for you
posts.description: Mo lives on your Mac screen and does the work for you: files, PDFs, photos, email, calendar, settings, routines and more, 232 tasks with no other app. Talk or type, get answers as cards, undo anything. Private, local models or your key. $19.99 once.

posts.name: SpaceO
posts.tagline: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac
posts.description: Give AI agents a separate display for real Mac apps while you keep working. Connect through MCP or the CLI, watch sessions in the Viewer, and take over when an agent needs help. Supports native apps and Chromium. Free and MIT licensed; Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Attention isolation, not a security sandbox: apps run as your macOS user. Runtime support depends on your macOS build.

posts.name: AwaitIO
posts.tagline: Write a TypeScript function, get an admin screen
posts.description: Turn async TypeScript functions into internal tools. Every await io.input shows a form in the browser and waits for the answer. Build a secure, self-hosted back office in minutes with zero frontend code and zero telemetry. Free for up to 3 users.

posts.name: CubbyPad
posts.tagline: Launchpad is back on macOS 26, and it's smarter
posts.description: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26. CubbyPad brings back the full-screen app grid: pages, folders you arrange, F4, hot corners and the trackpad pinch. Then it goes further: a search bar that does maths, opens System Settings pages and runs your Shortcuts; Apple Intelligence that sorts your apps into folders on your Mac; and a row of the apps you use at this time of day. One-time purchase for 2 Macs, in 20 languages.

posts.name: Tracked
posts.tagline: Time tracking, the Mac way.
posts.description: Native time tracking for freelancers who bill by the hour. Start a timer from the menu bar or the MacBook notch, and fix forgotten time by dragging blocks onto your day. Projects with hourly rates and budgets become PDF timesheets clients accept. A built-in MCP server lets Claude start timers and log your hours. Import your full history from Tyme, Toggl, Clockify, Harvest & more. No account, your data stays on your devices. One purchase covers Mac, iPhone, iPad & Apple Watch, widgets included.

posts.name: PixelShine
posts.tagline: Your Own AI Creative Studio + More 200 AI one tap apps...
posts.description: Create more, edit less. Bring your visual ideas to life with PixelShine AI — 200+ AI photo apps and free creative tools in one place.

posts.name: Arsaze
posts.tagline: Cursor for video editing. Make one cut, Tab the rest
posts.description: Arsaze is Cursor for video editing. Make one cut and press Tab: it previews your next edit on the timeline and learns how you cut. Edit the transcript like a doc, or let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit the real timeline while you watch, with every change versioned. Clients review on the exact frame, and your AI fixes their notes. Free plan: no-watermark exports, on-device transcription and unlimited review links. Windows, Mac, Linux, web and mobile.

posts.name: Alertedly
posts.tagline: Competitor intelligence for your team and AI agents
posts.description: Alertedly watches your competitors across 16 public channels: pricing pages, product launches, hiring, ads, Reddit, reviews, trademarks and more. Every change comes with its source. Get alerts in Slack, a clean brief in your inbox, or connect your AI agents over MCP and ask Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor "what did my competitors ship this month?" No more tracking competitors manually.

posts.name: iBoomto Local Chat
posts.tagline: Chat with your own files, on your own PC.
posts.description: A lightweight Windows app to chat with your files locally. Pick a model, download it once, drop in a PDF, and ask away. Local Chat is free and it labels every model so you know upfront if your PC can actually run it.

posts.name: PDFtada
posts.tagline: Free PDF tools that never upload your files
posts.description: PDFtada is a free PDF toolkit that runs 100% in your browser. Merge, compress to an exact KB, edit, sign, OCR, convert and unlock PDFs – 45+ tools with no uploads, no sign-up, no watermark and no daily limits. Built phone-first.

posts.name: Selah
posts.tagline: Memorize Bible verses one at a time, free and ad-free
posts.description: Selah helps you memorize Scripture and keep it. Pick a popular verse, a whole chapter, a themed pack, or any passage. Short exercises take you from reading to full recall: fill in the blanks, rebuild the verse, first-letter prompts, then say it from memory. Once you master a passage, spaced repetition brings it back at the right time so it sticks. Daily reminders at your pace. Free, with no ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

posts.name: landmine
posts.tagline: Lockfile in. Known bugs out. Before your agent edits.
posts.description: Your agent never checks GitHub for bugs in your exact versions. landmine does: it reads your lockfile, finds open issues filed against those versions, and gives the agent the bug and the workaround via AGENTS.md, a pre-edit hook or MCP. Free and open source.

posts.name: Treasures
posts.tagline: Keep the things you own, love, and discover together.
posts.description: Everything you love, in one little universe. There’s room for every find, with unlimited personal items and collections, now free. Share yours in Club, explore other collectors’ favorite pieces, and find inspiration for what comes next. Bring new finds into your collection with a photo or with our extensions. AI Autofill adds the details and assigns topics, while High mode searches online for images. New Image Styles give your finds a studio-style finish. Available on iOS, Android and web.

posts.name: ScreenShipper
posts.tagline: App Store & Google Play screenshots, ready in minutes
posts.description: Turn your app screens into store-ready screenshots. Pick from 100+ templates, write your copy, and export every iPhone, iPad and Android size in one ZIP. 50 languages with AI translation. Free to start, no design skills needed.

posts.name: static.md
posts.tagline: Markdown notes your AI agents can read and write
posts.description: Write markdown notes and whiteboards with your team, and let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code search, read and write them over MCP, and keep their memory there. You approve what each agent can do. Encrypted notes stay end-to-end. Free to start.

posts.name: Cursedy
posts.tagline: A tiny macOS menu-bar haunting
posts.description: A tiny macOS menu-bar haunting. Halloween emoji creep toward your cursor, gather into a swarm, and turn your endurance into a Cursedy Challenge certificate. Free to download.

posts.name: Dameter
posts.tagline: Don't move. Stare at your phone. Get graded by a sloth.
posts.description: Your laziness finally has a number. Dameter reads your steps, distance, active calories and Screen Time, then grades your day out of 500: the less you move and the longer you stare at your phone, the higher you score. Ranks go from F all the way up to SSS, and SSS takes a truly heroic amount of doing nothing. Your grader is Namataro, a slightly lonely sloth who writes in his diary every day, whether you show up or not. It's a joke app, but he takes the job very seriously. Free on iPhone.

posts.name: Fish Audio Realtime STT
posts.tagline: Realtime speech-to-text for voice agents, $0.36 an hour
posts.description: Fish Audio Realtime Speech to Text (transcribe-stream-1, in preview) streams audio over a WebSocket and returns transcripts turn by turn. It detects when the user has finished, tells speech from background noise, and recognizes backchannels like “mm-hm”. Per the docs, first draft text arrives about 0.5 seconds after speech starts. Supports 29 language codes, custom vocabulary, speaker tags and 8 to 48 kHz PCM audio. $0.36 per hour.

posts.name: EasyTour
posts.tagline: Most friendly app for your trips
posts.description: Most friendly app for your trips

posts.name: RuleInside
posts.tagline: Managed AI Voice Agents for WordPress Stores
posts.description: Stop answering every customer inquiry yourself. RuleInside gives your WordPress or WooCommerce store a team of AI agents that we build and run. Your shoppers get an answer at any hour. Each agent owns one job: answering questions, closing the sale, recovering carts, checking in after delivery or bringing back past buyers. They work by phone, website chat and WhatsApp, in the customer's language, using your live prices, stock and orders. A person still decides anything that moves money.

posts.name: Cenno
posts.tagline: Cenno: control your computer with hand spells
posts.description: Cenno turns hand movements into spells for your computer: point to move the cursor, pinch to click, swipe to change screens, open Mission Control, change the volume. Free, and fully local.

posts.tagline: Add a blog to your website without the busywork
posts.description: Add a fully customizable blog to your website without the hassle. Write, design, and publish posts in one dashboard, with SEO, analytics, and collaboration with teammates.

posts.description: UpBinger is complete marketing visibility automation. It checks how visible your brand is to Google and AI answers (SEO, AEO, GEO), shows which competitors AI picks instead, and writes SEO + AEO blogs that close the gaps. On social, BingerPilot audits your brand, learns its DNA, creates on-brand posters, carousels and Reels, and auto-posts them to Instagram and Facebook. Approve each post or let it run. Every post's insights shape the next plan. Free to start; paid plans from $5/month.

posts.description: Garchi CMS is an AI-native content operations platform. Agent changes arrive as drafts for a person to review and publish, with restore points for supported content, and approved posts can go to connected social channels from the same space.

posts.name: Finstatly
posts.tagline: Bank Statement Converter: PDF to Excel, CSV, QBO, OFX & more
posts.description: Finstatly is a bank statement converter for bookkeepers and accountants. Upload a PDF bank statement and download it as Excel, CSV, QBO, OFX or QIF, ready to review or import into QuickBooks, Xero, Quicken, Sage or MYOB. It reads statements from 1,000+ banks, including Chase, Bank of America and HSBC. Files are encrypted with AES-256 and deleted after processing. Start with 5 free pages, then plans from $25 a month, cancel any time.

posts.name: Metrochrome
posts.tagline: A pocket darkroom. Every film is a measurement
posts.description: A darkroom in your pocket. Load a roll, develop it, print from it — on film that is measured, not imagined: 36 emulsions digitised from the makers' own datasheets. Print with an enlarger head, ring-around, test strip, dodge and burn. Every film is free.

posts.description: Set a goal, show up every day and let your wall tell the story. Challenges, recurring tasks, proof and leaderboards for people and teams.

Built to help people reflect, understand their emotions, and develop healthier routines.

posts.description: TrendsFast is a commercial hosted API/MCP for niche trends, customer questions, competitor intelligence, short-video examples and search. Outputs include source links, dates, measured signals and coverage limits. New users get 100 credits once after verified signup. A separate MIT-licensed agent kit is available; the backend is proprietary.

posts.tagline: When was this website actually built? (Not just domain age)
posts.description: Enter any website to see its estimated launch date, how it has changed and what it's built with. Evidence-based, not just domain age. Free, no signup.

posts.tagline: Know what every AI user actually costs you
posts.description: Most AI products are priced on a guess, until one heavy user quietly wipes out your margin. Calcaas turns token costs into prices you can defend. Pick the models your product calls (4,000+ LLM, image, audio & video models from 80+ providers, synced weekly), set usage per customer, and get pricing tiers with margin, profit, MRR and break-even. Stress-test it, compare scenarios, export a branded PDF. Free to start. Pro is $49 once, no subscription.

posts.tagline: Learn any language, explained in the one you already speak
posts.description: Most language apps teach through English. Each day takes 10 minutes: new words with audio, a pronunciation check, a quiz that builds real sentences, and a live voice chat with Kite, an AI tutor that uses only the words you just learned. Exam speaking practice for Goethe, IELTS, OET and TEF. The 30 day course is free.

posts.tagline: The 5 website fixes to do first, with copy you can paste
posts.description: Enter a URL and get a score out of 100 and the 5 fixes to do first, ranked by impact and effort. 21 checks measure the facts, then AI rewrites weak headlines and buttons using only what it can quote from your page. One free audit a day, no signup.

posts.tagline: 25 websites built to sell one $1,000,000 book
posts.description: The problem: one copy of my book, priced at $1,000,000, and no buyer. The solution: 25 parody websites, from a streaming service with one title to a live auction stuck on "going once". For anyone who likes the internet weird. And one millionaire.

posts.description: Pika H3 Flex is a video generation model post-trained on MiniMax H3, with open weights. It handles text, image and reference-to-video plus editing, with up to 12 references, native stereo audio and exportable stems. Draft at 768p, upscale to 4K. Use it via the Pika API or Hugging Face.

posts.name: Cursed Cam
posts.tagline: Turn photos of your place into a haunted CCTV feed
posts.description: Upload photos of your home or venue and get a live night-vision CCTV monitor where something is very wrong. Each camera gets three AI clips. It plays on any TV, all night. One payment from $99, with a Pro plan for haunted attractions.

posts.name: Nudgeswipe
posts.tagline: Real product teardowns, tagged by behavioural bias
posts.description: 126 teardowns of real pricing pages, onboarding flows, paywalls and emails. Weekly newsletter every Friday if you want it.

posts.name: Laxis Agentic Voice Keyboard
posts.tagline: Just speak. Laxis writes it, because it knows you.
posts.description: An AI voice keyboard that really knows you. Say "reply to Kenji with pricing for both sites" in Gmail, Slack or any app. The Laxis agent drafts it from your meetings and the docs you upload, with your real facts and numbers. Or just dictate: about 4x faster than typing, polished as you speak, translated into 60+ languages. Voice keyboard + AI note taker in one app, one subscription. On Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android.

posts.tagline: Deck builder for your agent. Topic in, slides out.
posts.description: No template library. slide-wright is a free, open-source (MIT) agent skill that invents a palette, type system and layout for each deck, then shows a two-slide preview before it builds the rest. Pick your horror: Glitch shreds your screen with torn slices and red/cyan ghosts, Broken Matrix makes your display look cursed with dead pixels, Halloween unleashes the zombie. 👻 The harder the slap, the scarier the result. Free, MIT licensed.

posts.tagline: ISO/IEC 27028 recorded
posts.description: ISO/IEC 27028 recorded: all five control attributes for 93 controls, the publication record, a free attribute check and a USD 799 kit.

posts.name: Amino Supplement Scanner
posts.tagline: Supplement analysis and personalized recommendations
posts.description: Amino is the smart supplement app to log your routine, analyze safety, effectiveness, and find the best products. Whole foods alone can't fully optimize your health, and some supplements can be toxic. Amino helps you maximize your routine, safely.

posts.name: BRAIN PROTEIN™
posts.tagline: Premium sardines in tomato sauce for late nights
posts.description: Fuel for the walking dead. Real protein for unreal deadlines. Illustrative artwork; actual packaging may differ.

posts.name: Travellar
posts.tagline: Turn your trip photos into an animated map Reel
posts.description: AI Trip Finder spots the trips in your camera roll 🏞️ and proposes a Reel for each 🎬: 🗺️ Every place you went on an animated map 📍 With the best photos at each stop 🔒 Chosen on the iPhone without uploading them Free to make and share 🙌

posts.name: TrickGuard
posts.tagline: a free AI prompt-injection game
posts.description: TrickGuard is a free browser game about prompt injection. An AI guard knows a password and is told never to say it. You get a few messages to trick it. Five gates, each stricter: later guards filter their own output, so you need acrostics and riddles.

posts.name: QRCard
posts.tagline: Digital business cards and vehicle QR tags, no app needed
posts.description: QRCard gives you a live digital business card in about two minutes. Share it as a link or QR code and people save you to their phone contacts in one tap, with no app on either side. Update details any time, add links and a booking page, capture leads and see who viewed your card. Also new: Vehicle Smart Tags. Put a QR tag on your car, bike or EV so anyone can call or WhatsApp you about a blocked driveway or emergency. Free to start.

posts.name: Raziel
posts.tagline: Alternative Asset Management Platform for Investors
posts.description: Alternative asset management platform. Investors track startups, SPVs and funds with MOIC, IRR and TVPI in one dashboard. Founders manage their cap table, investor pipeline, investor updates and KPIs.

posts.name: GoDotWebs
posts.tagline: A professional career coach, social worker, and counselor
posts.description: Achieve absolute clarity. We map your trajectory using predictive modeling, institutional data, and advanced cognitive coaching.

posts.name: NextConstraint
posts.tagline: Find the leak costing your SaaS the most.
posts.description: NextConstraint helps SaaS founders figure out what to fix next. You connect your payments, website analytics and sign-ups, and it works out how much money each step of your funnel is losing compared with your own past numbers. It then picks the most expensive problem and gives you one specific fix. After you make the change, it measures the same number again and tells you whether the fix improved it, made no difference, or made it worse.

posts.name: Whisperlane
posts.tagline: An elegant speech-to-text companion for Windows & agents
posts.description: Free, open source, local-first dictation for Windows. Hold a key, talk, and it is typed - into your editor, your terminal, or your agent.

posts.name: ShareSEER
posts.tagline: Generate investment ideas by following insiders
posts.description: Shareseer is a research tool to generate investment ideas by following insider transactions and efficiently view company filings and financials,

posts.name: Calmstats
posts.tagline: Cookieless web analytics that follows the money
posts.description: Calmstats is cookieless web analytics that ties every visit to the revenue it brings in. Know which channel, campaign, post, or AI assistant sends paying customers. Connect Polar, Stripe or Whop for first- and last-touch attribution. Tracks AI traffic, funnels, goals, and real-time visitors. Free plan available. Privacy-first (no cookies, respects Do Not Track).

posts.name: Facebook Reels Controls
posts.tagline: Customize Facebook Reels controls and behavior
posts.description: Customize Facebook Reels with cleaner controls and useful playback options. Hide distracting controls until you need them, move the Reel menu to either side, customize progress effects, assign keyboard shortcuts, auto-scroll through Reels, skip ads, and skip selected creators.

posts.name: GraveBot
posts.tagline: The Million Dollar Homepage, but for dead AI bots
posts.description: As people debate AI consciousness, GraveBot reimagines The Million Dollar Homepage as a 3D cemetery for abandoned bots. Companies get a spot for their logo, epitaph and sponsored backlink—a playful way to be seen, with no promise of SEO value.

posts.name: Wizstar Product-to-Video
posts.tagline: One Image. Endless Ad-Ready Videos.
posts.description: Wizstar Product-to-Video helps e-commerce sellers and marketers create landscape and vertical videos for product pages, TikTok, Meta, and other advertising platforms. A single product image is enough to generate advertising-ready videos. With just a few clicks, users can turn product images into professional-quality videos without filming or editing, dramatically reducing production time and costs while creating more content with zero hassle.

posts.name: Indiecorns
posts.tagline: Connect with indie builders and share your progress
posts.description: Build Together, Grow Together. Join the global indie hacker collective to connect with builders, share wins, and grow together.

posts.name: Terralien: Geography Quiz
posts.tagline: Follow alien orders. Find your targets on Earth.
posts.description: A geography quiz on a 3D globe. Follow an alien commander's orders, aim at countries and discover how well you know Earth. Play in your browser, with English, Spanish and Russian text. Free entry with optional in-game purchases.

posts.name: Menu Translator to English
posts.tagline: Offline menu translator with prices in US dollars
posts.description: Take a photo of a menu in Mexico or Spain, slide the frame over a dish, and read it in English with the price in USD next to the pesos or euros. Works offline, keeps a running total of your order, and collects no data. French and Italian too.

posts.name: One Million Sad Pups
posts.tagline: Make a sad pup happy, for you or someone who loves dogs
posts.description: Pan and zoom a yard of a million digital sad pups. Pick one, name it and watch it turn happy, sealed with an absurdly official Certificate of Pup Happiness. Keep the moment for yourself, or gift it to the dog lover in your life, named after them.

posts.name: PetHubble
posts.tagline: Your dog and cat health records, all in one app
posts.description: PetHubble is a care app for dogs and cats. Vaccines, vet documents, medications, weight, symptoms and walks all live in one place. Snap a photo of a vaccine booklet or a vet bill and it suggests what to save and which reminders to set. Share a pet with family or a sitter so everyone gets the same reminders. Free plan on iOS and Android, data hosted in the EU. Your dog and cat health records, all in one app

posts.name: INTARC
posts.tagline: Weekly profit check for app studios
posts.description: See what each app really keeps. Spot ad spend that won’t pay back. Read-only, no SDK.

posts.name: PlateParrot
posts.tagline: Your Smarter Grocery List
posts.description: PlateParrot turns your recipes into one grocery list. Use the AI MCP: You plan meals, and the ingredients land on your list by themselves. Pick the servings and the ingredients land on your list, with amounts added up across recipes. The list is sorted by the sections of your supermarket, so you walk the store once. Share a list with your household: everyone sees the same list, and check-offs show up on every phone. Free for iOS and Android.
